prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn window_summary(events: &[(i64,i64)], start: i64, end: i64, limit: i32) -> Option<(usize,i64)>
Behavior: Reject start greater than end or a negative limit. Select events with timestamps in [start,end), order by timestamp with original order breaking ties, keep only the latest limit, and return (kept count,value sum). Limit zero returns zeros.
Visible example: events (8,5),(3,2),(8,7),(10,99),(6,4), window [3,10), limit 3 returns (3,16).

Buggy source to repair:

pub fn window_summary(events:&[(i64,i64)],start:i64,end:i64,limit:i32)->Option<(usize,i64)>{let a:Vec<_>=events.iter().filter(|x|x.0>=start&&x.0<=end).take(limit as usize).collect();Some((a.len(),a.iter().map(|x|x.1).sum()))}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: pub fn window_summary(events:&[(i64,i64)],start:i64,end:i64,limit:i32)->Option<(usize,i64)>{if start>end||limit<0{return None}let mut a:Vec<_>=events.iter().enumerate().filter(|(_,x)|x.0>=start&&x.0<end).map(|(i,x)|(x.0,x.1,i)).collect();a.sort_by_key(|x|(x.0,x.2));let keep=limit as usize;if a.len()>keep{a.drain(..a.len()-keep);}Some((a.len(),a.iter().map(|x|x.1).sum()))}
